tha-ap2:2.1: Tathāgataṃ Jetavane vasantaṃ apucchi Vedehamuni nataṅgo: / ‘Paccekabuddhā kira nāma honti bhavanti te hetuhi kehi dhīrā?' // //
tha-ap2:3.1: Tadāha sabbaññuvaro mahesi Ānandabhaddaṃ madhurassarena: / Ye sabbabuddhesu katādhikārā aladdhamokkhā Jinasāsanesu. // //
tha-ap2:4.1: Ten' eva saṃvegamukhena dhīrā vināpi buddhehi sutikkhapaññā / ārammaṇenāpi parittakena paccekabodhiṃ anupāpuṇanti. // //
tha-ap2:5.1: Sabbamhi *lokamhi mamaṃ ṭha*petvā paccekabuddhehi samo 'va n' atthi. / Tesaṃ imaṃ vaṇṇapadesamattaṃ vakkhām' ahaṃ sādhu mahāmunīnaṃ. // //
tha-ap2:6.1: Sayaṃ eva buddhānaṃ mahāisīnaṃ sādhūni vākyāni madhuñ ca khuddaṃ / anuttaraṃ bhesajaṃ patthayantā suṇotha sabbe supasannacittā. // //
tha-ap2:7.1: *Paccekabuddhānaṃ samāga*tānaṃ paramparavyākaraṇāni yāni / ādīnavo yañ ca virāgavatthuṃ yathā ca bodhiṃ anupāpuṇiṃsu. // //
tha-ap2:8.1: Saṃrāgavatthūsu virāgasaññī rattamhi lokamhi virattacittā / hitvā papañcaṃ jitaphanditāni tatth' eva bodhiṃ anupāpuṇiṃsu. // //
tha-ap2:9.1: Sabbesu bhūtesu nidhāya daṇḍaṃ aviheṭhayaṃ aññataram pi tesaṃ / mettena cittena hitānukampī eko care khaggavisānakappo. // //
tha-ap2:10.1: *Sabbesu bhūtesu nidhāya daṇḍaṃ aviheṭhayaṃ aññataraṃ pi tesaṃ / na puttam iccheyya kuto sahāyaṃ eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:11.1: Saṃsaggajātassa bhavanti snehā snehanvayaṃ dukkhaṃ idaṃ pahoti / ādīnavaṃ snehajaṃ pekkhamāno eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:12.1: Mitte suhajje anukampamāno hāpeti atthaṃ paṭibandhacitto / etaṃ bhayaṃ santhave pekkhamāno eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:13.1: Vaṃso visālo va yathā visatto puttesu dāresu ca yā apekkhā / vaṃsakkaḷīro va asajjamāno eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:14.1: Migo araññamhi yathā abandho yenicchakaṃ gacchati gocarāya / viññu naro seritaṃ pekkhamāno eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:15.1: Āmantaṇā hoti sahāyamajjhe vāse ṭhāne gamane cārikāya / anabhijjhitaṃ seritaṃ pekkhamāno eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:16.1: Khiḍḍā ratī hoti sahāyamajjhe puttesu pemaṃ vipulañ ca hoti / piyavippayogaṃ vijigucchamāno eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:17.1: Catuddiso appaṭigho ca hoti santussamāno itarītarena / parissayānaṃ sahitā achambhī eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:18.1: Dussaṅgahā pabbajitā pi eke atho gahaṭṭhā gharam āvasantā / apposukko paraputtesu hutvā eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:19.1: Oropayitvā gihibyañjanāni sañchinnapatto yathā koviḷāro / chetvāna vīro gihibandhanāni eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:20.1: Sace labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhuvihāri dhīraṃ / abhibhūya sabbāni parissayāni careyya ten' attamano satīmā. // //
tha-ap2:21.1: No ce labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhuvihāri dhīraṃ / rājā 'va raṭṭhaṃ vijitaṃ pahāya eko care mātaṅgaraññe va nāgo. // //
tha-ap2:22.1: addhā pasaṃsāma sahāyasampadaṃ seṭṭhā samā sevitabbā sahāyā / ete aladdhā anavajjabhojī eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:23.1: Disvā suvaṇṇassa pabhassarāni kammāraputtena suniṭṭhitāni / saṅghaṭṭamānāni duve bhujasmiṃ eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:24.1: Evaṃ dutiyena sahā mam' assa vācābhilāpo abhisajjanā vā / etaṃ bhayaṃ āyatiṃ pekkhamāno eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:25.1: Kāmā hi citrā madhurā manoramā virūparūpena mathenti cittaṃ / ādīnavaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:26.1: Ītī ca gaṇḍo ca upaddavo ca rogo ca sallañ ca bhayañ ca m' etaṃ / etaṃ bhayaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:27.1: Sītañ ca uṇhañ ca khudaṃ pipāsaṃ vātātape daṃsasiriṃsape cā / sabbāni p' etāni abhibhavitvā eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:28.1: Nāgo va yūthāni vivajjayitvā sañjātakhandho padumī uḷāro / yathābhirantaṃ viharaṃ araññe eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:29.1: Aṭṭhāna taṃ sāṅgaṇikāratassa yaṃ phassaye sāmayikaṃ vimuttiṃ / Ādiccabandhussa vaco nisamma eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:30.1: Diṭṭhīvisūkāni upātivatto patto niyāmaṃ paṭiladdhamaggo / uppannañāṇo 'mhi anaññaneyyo eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:31.1: Nillolupo nikkuho nippipāso nimmakkho niddhantakasāvamoho / nirāsayo sabbaloke bhavitvā eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:32.1: Pāpaṃ sahāyaṃ parivajjayetha anatthadassiṃ visame niviṭṭhaṃ / sayaṃ na seve pasutaṃ pamattaṃ eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:33.1: Bahussutaṃ dhammadharaṃ bhajetha mittaṃ uḷāraṃ paṭibhānavantaṃ / aññāya atthāni vineyya kaṅkhaṃ eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:34.1: Khiḍḍaṃ ratiṃ kāmasukhañ ca loke analaṅkaritvā anapekkhamāno / vibhūsanaṭṭhānā virato saccavādī eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:35.1: Puttañ ca dāraṃ pitarañ ca mātaraṃ dhanāni dhaññāni ca bandhavāni ca / hitvāna kāmāni yathodhikāni eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:36.1: Saṅgo eso parittaṃ ettha sokhyaṃ app' assādo dukkhaṃ ev' ettha bhiyyo / kaṇḍo eso iti ñatvā matīmā eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:37.1: Sandālayitvāna saṃyojanāni jālaṃ pahitvā salil' ambucārī / aggīva daḍḍham anivattamāno eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:38.1: Okkhittacakkhū na ca pādalolo guttindriyo rakkhitamānasāno / anavassuto appariḍayhamāno eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:39.1: Ohārayitvā gihibyañjanāni sañchinnapatto yathā pāricchatto / kāsāyavattho abhinikkhamitvā eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:40.1: Rasesu gedhaṃ akaraṃ alolo anaññaposī sapadānacārī / kule kule appaṭibaddhacitto eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:41.1: Pahāya pañcāvaraṇāni cetaso upakkilese byapanujja sabbe / anissito chetvā snehapadosaṃ eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:42.1: Vipiṭṭhikatvāna sukhaṃ dukkhañ ca pubbe va somanassaṃ domanassaṃ / laddhān' upekkhaṃ samathaṃ visuddhaṃ eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:43.1: Āraddhaviriyo paramatthapattiyā alīnacitto akusītavutti / daḷhanikkamo thāmabalūpapanno eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:44.1: Paṭisallānajhānaṃ ariñcamāno dhammesu niccaṃ anudhammacārī / ādīnavaṃ sammasitā bhavesu eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:45.1: Taṇhakkhayaṃ patthayaṃ appamatto anelamūgo sutavā satīmā / saṅkhātadhammo niyato padhānavā eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:46.1: Sīho va saddesu asantasanto vāto va jālamhi asajjamāno / padumaṃ va toyena alimpamāno eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:47.1: Sīho yathā dāṭhabalī pasayha rājā migānaṃ abhibhuyyacārī / sevetha pantāni senāsanāni eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:48.1: Mettam upekkhaṃ karuṇaṃ vimuttiṃ āsevamāno muditañ ca kāle / sabbena lokena avirujjhamāno eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:49.1: Rāgañ ca dosañ ca pahāya mohaṃ sandālayitvāna saṃyojanāni / asantasaṃ jīvitasaṅkhayamhi eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. // //
tha-ap2:50.1: Bhajanti sevanti ca kāraṇatthā nikkāraṇā dullabhā ajja mittā / attaṭṭhapaññā asucī manussā eko care khaggavisānakappo.* // //
tha-ap2:51.1: Visuddhasīlā suvisuddhapaññā samāhitā jāgariyānuyuttā / vipassakā dhammavisesadassī maggaṅgabojjhaṅgagate vijaññā. // //
tha-ap2:52.1: Puññappaṇidhiñ ca tathānimittaṃ āsevayitvā Jinasāsanamhi / ye sāvakattaṃ na vajanti dhīrā bhavanti paccekajinā sayambhū. // //
tha-ap2:53.1: Mahantadhammā bahudhammakāyā cittissarā sabbadukkhoghatiṇṇā / udaggacittā paramatthadassī sīhopamā khaggavisāṇakappā. // //
tha-ap2:54.1: Santindriyā santamānā samādhī paccanta sattesu satippacārā / dīpā parattha idha vijjalantā paccekabuddhā satataṃ hitā 'me. // //
tha-ap2:55.1: Pahīnasabbāvaraṇā janindā lokappadīpā ghanakañcanābhā / nisaṃsayaṃ lokasudakkhiṇeyyā paccekabuddhā satataṃ hitā 'me. // //
tha-ap2:56.1: Paccekabuddhānaṃ subhāsitāni caranti lokamhi sadevakamhi / sutvā tathā ye na karonti bālā bhamanti dukkhesu punappunan te. // //
tha-ap2:57.1: Paccekabuddhānaṃ subhāsitāni madhuṃ yathā khuddam iva ssavantaṃ / sutvā tathā ye paṭipattiyuttā bhavanti te saccadasā sapaññā. // //
tha-ap2:58.1: Paccekabuddhehi Jinehi vuttā gāthā uḷārā abhinikkhamitvā / tā Sakyasīhena naruttamena pakāsitā dhammavijānanatthaṃ. // //
tha-ap2:59.1: Lokānukampāya imāni tesaṃ paccekabuddhānaṃ vikubbitāni / saṃvegasaṅgāmativaḍḍhanatthaṃ sayambhusīhena pakāsitāni ti // //
